text:
Marta (CSM): Starting prep for HelixCare QBR  focus: token econ, onboarding gaps, renewal risk. Can we get a concise burn snapshot + two cost scenarios?
Noah (FinOps): Need last 60d daily burn, baseline monthly $ and committed credits left. Also propose hard cap behavior if spend spikes >40% month-over-month.
Sofia (Data): I'll pull last 90d daily by feature (gen vs embed) and model. SQL: ```SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) d, feature, SUM(tokens) t FROM usage WHERE account='helixcare' AND ts >= now()-interval '90 days' GROUP BY d,feature ORDER BY d;``` ETA 2h.
Evan (AM): Heads up customer plans an internal pilot for semantic search next sprint; embeddings will spike. They asked for a "cost-safe" rollout checklist.
Marta (CSM): For slides: 1) current burn + model mix, 2) scenario A: 2x embed for 30d, 3) scenario B: steady 7% QoQ growth, 4) alert thresholds + playbook + enablement ask.
Noah (FinOps): Recommend soft alert at +25% vs baseline, critical at +50% OR credits <12%. Auto-mitigation: throttle embedding throughput to a safe tier and notify CSM/AM. Agree?
Sofia (Data): Pulled raw last30d: gen=64,200,000 tokens, embed=22,800,000 tokens. Uploaded CSV to /shared/qbr/helix_tokens_1755.csv.
qbr-bot: File uploaded: https://redwood.internal/qbr/helix_tokens_1755.csv (baseline forecast +10% appended).
Marta (CSM): @Sofia can you run scenarios and output token->$ using model mix: gen $0.00065/token, embed $0.00125/token? Include month delta and runway in months.
Sofia (Data): Running scenarios now. Will attach two CSVs and a small chart pack.
Evan (AM): I'll draft the customer-facing "cost-safe" checklist: gate non-prod traffic, staged pilot with rate limits, low-dim embeddings option, and enable batching + KV cache. Want the one-pager by EOD.
Noah (FinOps): I'll draft an ops one-pager with concrete knobs: batch size 32 default, max embedding QPS 18, soft cap rule, and a Console toggle for snooze during enablement. Will add playbook contacts.
Marta (CSM): Also include instructions for tagging approved spikes (ticket id + duration) so billing can be reconciled.
Sofia (Data): Scenario A (2x embed for 30d) -> ~+48% cost that month. Scenario B (7% QoQ steady) -> +7%, +14%, +22% across three months. Uploaded: https://redwood.internal/qbr/helix_scenarioA.csv, https://redwood.internal/qbr/helix_scenarioB.csv
qbr-bot: Charts generated: https://redwood.internal/qbr/helix_charts_1755.png. Checklist updated: "HelixCare cost scenarios + runbook" assigned to Marta, due in 16 hours.
Evan (AM): Tentative enablement slot Thurs 2pm PT. I'll confirm and include agenda: 35min demo (batching+cache), 10min Q&A, 10min ops/playbook.
Noah (FinOps): Monitoring config created in staging: `alerts/helixcare/budget`. I added `snooze_window` flag and test webhook.
Marta (CSM): Great. Action items: Sofia attach final CSVs/charts, Noah finalize playbook + monitor, Evan confirm session, Marta assemble QBR deck and circulate by tomorrow 9am PT. Ping me for blockers. :white_check_mark:
